descriptor.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
descriptor.scope: IGN assembly of vectorised DGFiP cadastral parcels across France; bounded Paris, Lyon, Marseille and Lille metropolitan-settlement entries are enabled. Each added city has separate bounded evidence in additionalCityEvidence and cityScopes. Non-vectorised areas and cadastral alignment gaps remain possible.
descriptor.attribution: IGN/DGFiP, Parcellaire Express (PCI), catalogue and updates linked; accessed October 2, 2026. Licence Ouverte 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

cityScopes.marseille: 331 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 331 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32631 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Marseille commune; the unchanged WUP point lies within returned parcel geometry. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
cityScopes.lille: 281 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 281 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32631 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Lille metropolitan settlement locator near Marcq-en-Barœul, which is a separate commune. The initial query restricted to Lille commune 59350 returned no parcel at the WUP point; the existing nationwide IGN provider verifies nearby ground at the unchanged locator without that municipal restriction. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
